title: Probabilistic State Space Enumeration in Neural Network Computation
abstract: arXiv:2611.15062v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many methods for pruning neural networks rank weights or groups of weights by importance and retain a single subset. We study how channel groups contribute jointly to the output of multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in Transformer language models. Inspired by network reliability analysis, probabilistic state space enumeration (PSSE) represents the dense MLP output as the expected importance-corrected masked output over $2^G$ joint states of $G$ channel groups. Summing the most probable states' probability-weighted outputs gives an approximation whose absolute error is bounded by the omitted probability mass times the maximum masked-output norm. NORDER-II adapts ORDER-II to enumerate states in decreasing probability without sorting the full space. Its first $B$ states maximize the probability mass captured at that budget. A weight-entropy scorer fixes each layer's ordering from pretrained weights. We evaluate all 168 MLP layers across six

translated_title: 神经网络计算中的概率状态空间枚举
translated_abstract: 许多剪枝神经网络的方法会根据重要性对权重或权重组进行排序，并保留单一子集。我们研究了Transformer语言模型中多层感知机（MLP）的通道组如何共同贡献于输出。受网络可靠性分析的启发，概率状态空间枚举（PSSE）将密集的MLP输出表示为G个通道组的2^G个联合状态上经过重要性校正的掩码输出的期望值。对最可能状态的概率加权输出进行求和可得到一个近似结果，其绝对误差受被省略的概率质量乘以最大掩码输出范数所限定。NORDER-II对ORDER-II进行了改进，可以按概率递减的顺序枚举状态，而无需对整个状态空间进行排序。其前B个状态在该预算下能最大化所捕获的概率质量。权重熵评分器根据预训练权重为每一层确定固定的排序。我们在六个（模型的）全部168个MLP层上进行了评估……
tldr: 该论文受网络可靠性分析启发，提出概率状态空间枚举方法（PSSE），将Transformer中MLP的密集输出表示为通道组联合状态上重要性校正掩码输出的期望，并配合NORDER-II算法高效枚举高概率状态，实现具有可证明误差界限的高效近似。
en_tdlr: Inspired by network reliability analysis, this paper proposes Probabilistic State Space Enumeration (PSSE), which represents the dense MLP output in Transformers as the expected importance-corrected masked output over joint states of channel groups, with NORDER-II efficiently enumerating the most probable states under provable error bounds.
